confirmation_policy: All Train is known development evidence; no unseen holdout claim. Historical Valid and Valid prohibited.
baseline: Saved SLOW_CONTROL from DM-20261002-05; unchanged size_liquidity block, no smoothing. MOM60 descriptive only.

slow_control.role: immutable primary anchor; rebuild bitwise with unchanged original module/inputs

feature_definitions.timing: Signal t at start of exchange session (00:00 JST). Prices/Volume/Sector use tau=common previous exchange session as in prior experiment; absent tau stock row remains missing. Date-only financial disclosure available at 23:59:59 JST, earliest subsequent common signal session (including weekend disclosures before next session).
feature_definitions.fundamental_column: ForecastOperatingProfit only, total full-year management operating-profit forecast. CurrentFiscalYearStartDate and CurrentFiscalYearEndDate exact pair. No NextYearForecast, EPS, ordinary/net-income, nonconsolidated-field or performance-driven fallback.
feature_definitions.revision_comparability: Latest finite current full-year forecast minus previous finite forecast for same Code/fiscal start/end/accounting basis; divide by latest strictly-positive PIT TotalAssets at that disclosure. Basis inferred causally from TypeOfDocument financial statements; revisions inherit prior known basis; unknown basis cannot compare.
feature_definitions.assets: Use most recent finite positive TotalAssets already disclosed in same inherited accounting basis. Scale locked at revision disclosure; no future restatement.
feature_definitions.FRESH_FUND_EVENT: Each latest disclosure is queried backward at signal midnight; fresh iff available_at is strictly after previous signal midnight and before/equal signal midnight. A comparable finite nonzero FundDelta is an event, including if Assets unavailable; unknown/noncomparable/unchanged is not an event. No revision alpha state carry. If multiple disclosures between sessions, latest disclosure is authoritative. Missing scale gives zero overlay but a known fresh revision still excludes Flow. First-session cutoff uses negative infinity; all available prior disclosures eligible.
feature_definitions.FUND_EVENT_RAW: Fresh only: (ForecastOperatingProfit-current previous same fiscal/basis forecast)/PITAssets, else NaN; upward positive/downward negative.
feature_definitions.SectorShock: Residual=raw_return-beta*TOPIX on each historical date. Equal-weight mean of finite residuals in exact contemporaneous PIT33 membership within raw-return universe; self-inclusive, minimum1 finite member (no user-requested size threshold). Unknown9999/blank missing. Map own PIT33 at tau to daily return at tau; no17/fallback/LOO/blend/horizon.
feature_definitions.AbnormalVolume: log1p(raw Volume_tau >=0) minus median of log1p volumes on immediately preceding20 price-observation rows of that Code/relisting segment; all20 must be finite nonnegative, otherwise missing. Zero volume valid. Gap>20 absent calendar sessions resets. No window or threshold search.
feature_definitions.FLOW_EVENT_RAW: Only no FreshFundEvent AND finite WithinShock<0 AND finite AbnormalVolume>0: -WithinShock*max(AbnormalVolume,0); otherwise NaN. Fresh Fund priority including missing scale.
feature_definitions.event_rank: Only active finite event values: (2*average_rank-(n+1))/n, same-date event cross-section; all others exactly 0. Singleton/all ties give 0. Rank across all fund signs together. Centering may make smaller positive Flow negative; no post-result sign adjustment.
feature_definitions.SlowRank: Same-date centered average percentile rank of unchanged SLOW_CONTROL, exactly the existing centered_rank formula; prove identical official weights/P/L to saved SLOW_CONTROL.
feature_definitions.SLOW_CAUSE_AWARE: SlowRank+FundOverlay+FlowOverlay; event supports mutually exclusive; SectorShock never score-added.
feature_definitions.anchor_inputs: Original dm_slow_multifactor loader fields unchanged (including dormant Sector17Code); original global size_liquidity computation unchanged. Sector17 is never used by anchor global score or new overlay. Original normalization/imputation belongs only to frozen anchor; no overlay median imputation.

model: Two fixed label-free sparse overlays on immutable anchor. No fit, optimizer, candidate search.
selection_rule: Conjunction of all requested criteria versus SLOW_CONTROL; B additional A-relative gates. Stop after 2 trials. Eligibility means next-stage research only.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block on concatenated eligible sessions; no holding resets

diagnostics.cumulative: sum of consecutive official residual targets t through t+h-1, require all finite and t+h+1 maturity within same fold; no stock-row compression or segment crossing
diagnostics.persistent: Fresh revisions up/down separately, regardless magnitude availability; pooled/ex2016/year summaries and event-level panel. Observational diagnostic only.
diagnostics.industry: Negative StockRawReturn at tau split SectorShock<0 versus >=0; missing separate. No sector portfolio.
diagnostics.pressure: No FreshFundEvent and WithinShock<0 split AbnormalVolume>0 versus <=0; missing separate; no horizon candidate.
diagnostics.states: Negative raw stock move only, ordered PERSISTENT_INFO fresh FundDelta<0; COMMON_INDUSTRY no fresh fund AND SectorShock<0; TRANSIENT_PRESSURE no fresh fund AND SectorShock>=0 AND WithinShock<0 AND AbnormalVolume>0; OTHER. Observed proxy classification, not causal identification. Save counts/next mean/HAC5 RankIC/Long/Short membership/gross contribution for each book.
diagnostics.turnover: Full-panel continuous official stock weights. Sum |w-wprev| split CURRENT_EVENT/PRIOR_EVENT_ONLY/NON_EVENT (current and prior union event-active), further entry/exit/resize/sign-flip, and rank displacement versus immutable anchor membership. Rank displacement is an orthogonal attribution, not added to entry/exit. Missing-target official charged costs and all-position costs both reconcile. Save candidate minus anchor and B minus A decompositions.
